name: Straight-arm Cable Pulldown
variation: Standing upright with two independent high-cable handles
setup: Use two high cable handles; start with a light load.
Stand tall with feet planted and handles around shoulder height.
Keep a small, steady bend in both elbows.

advice.tip: Pull through your upper arms while keeping your torso steady.
commonMistakes: Turning the movement into an elbow-bending pulldown.
Leaning back or swinging to move the load.
Letting the weight stacks drop on the return.

beats.label: Reach
beats.cue: Start with handles around shoulder height.

beats.label: Brace
beats.cue: Brace your torso; keep elbows softly fixed.

beats.label: Pull to thighs
beats.cue: Sweep your upper arms toward your sides.

beats.label: Squeeze
beats.cue: Finish near thighs without leaning back.

beats.label: Control return
beats.cue: Let the handles rise under control.

beats.label: Reset
beats.cue: Keep your stance steady before repeating.
